notes:
ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only (curl with a real browser UA). robots.txt is a Shopify agentic-commerce robots.txt with 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' for all public product/collection/page content, no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow, so no block on any tier; never needed Playwright or Chrome. TREE: built from union of top nav (Shop dropdown: News, Tableware, Kitchen, Candles, Home decor, Seasonal decor, Textiles, Lighting, Furniture, Outdoor living, Most Popular), each top category's own subcategory-link strip, sitemap_collections_1.xml, and breadcrumbs on leaf pages. QTY: read the rendered '

N products

' header on each live collection page (no query params / no filters applied) -- this differed substantially and consistently downward from the collection's own /collections/.json 'products_count' field (e.g. Cushions json=77 vs rendered=55, Kitchen Textiles json=18 vs rendered=5), confirming the known Shopify products_count-is-inflated issue, so the .json field was NOT used for any qty. EXCLUDED and why: Furniture > Storage and Shelves (Wardrobe, Modular Shelving, Wall Shelves, Coat Racks) -- explicitly nested under the site's own Furniture nav/breadcrumb, so per storage.md Sec21/27 'prefer Furniture when site places it under Furniture' -- out of scope for this Storage array. Kitchen > Bread Baskets and Trays, Chopping Boards, Kitchen Accessories, Ovenware -- Kitchen & Dining, not Textile/Storage. Tableware > Cutlery, Glassware, Table Decor, Tableware Dinnerware, Napkin Rings, Paper Napkins -- non-textile tableware/hardware (napkin rings=hardware, paper napkins=paper not fabric). Home decor > Candlesticks, Flowerpots, Home Decoration, Hurricanes and Lanterns, Mirrors, Stationery, Vases -- Decorative Home Accessories, not Storage. Outdoor living > Outdoor Furniture, Outdoor Candles -- other categories (only Outdoor Textiles qualified). Christmas > Christmas Candles, Christmas News, Christmas Table Setting, Garlands, Ornaments, Tree Toppers -- non-textile seasonal decor (only Christmas Textiles qualified; verified the two underlying products, Karla Christmas Calendar and Karla Cone Ornament, are listed as Cotton/Textile material on their product pages before including). Cross-cutting/promotional collections excluded per Sec27/Sec35 View-All rule: New Textiles, New Rugs, New Storage, Textiles Bestsellers, Accessories Bestsellers, Most Popular, News, Shop, Easter, Easter New Arrivals (no textile/storage subcats found there). No grouping parent was recorded for Outdoor Textiles, Tablecloth/Cloth Napkins/Placemats-Runners-Coasters, Kitchen Textiles, Christmas Textiles, Storage (accessories-storage) or Kitchen Storage because their real site parents (Outdoor Living, Tableware/Table Decor, Kitchen, Seasonal Decor/Christmas, Home Decor) are mixed categories whose other children do not belong in Textile/Storage -- only the pure 'Textiles' node (Cushions/Throws/Bedspreads/Rugs, home-textiles handle) qualified as a real group since all 4 of its own subcategory-link children are Textile. 'Storage' (accessories-storage) contains a mix of baskets plus hook racks/magazine holder; kept as one category-level qty per the site's own 'Storage' breadcrumb/category naming (confidence MEDIUM) rather than filtering product-by-product, per task scope being category-level not product-level.
